jobs.description:
Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.

To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

Michael Page is a global leader in specialized recruitment, connecting top talent with leading companies across a wide range of industries. With a strong international presence and a people-focused culture, Michael Page offers a dynamic environment where ambition and career growth are encouraged.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the end-to-end recruitment process.
• Develop and maintain a portfolio of clients.
• Source, interview, and assess qualified candidates.
• Build long-term relationships with clients and candidates.
• Provide recruitment advice and market insights.
• Negotiate offers and support placements.
• Contribute to business growth through commercial activities.

• Previous experience in sales, business development, customer-facing roles, or recruitment is a strong advantage.
• Commercial mindset with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Driven, resilient, and target-oriented.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• Fluent in French & Dutch, French & English, or Dutch & English.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international, and performance-driven environment.

Our client is a leading international insurance company with a strong presence in the Belgian market. Through innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence, the organization continuously invests in transforming and growing their Business Units.

To support the successful execution of its strategic ambitions, our client is currently looking for a Strategic Change Analyst to join its Brussels-based office.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the definition, structuring and monitoring of the Business Unit strategic roadmap
• Translate strategic priorities into compelling communication materials, executive presentations and impactful storytelling
• Prepare presentations, reports and strategic updates for senior management and executive committees
• Conduct business and strategic analyses to support decision-making and identify growth opportunities
• Perform ad hoc studies related to profitability, operational efficiency, organizational effectiveness and innovation
• Develop recommendations and action plans based on data-driven insights
• Contribute to the optimization and simplification of internal processes across the business unit
• Coordinate and monitor strategic initiatives, transformation projects and change management activities
• Support the annual budgeting process and oversee the monitoring of business unit operating expenses
• Prepare financial analyses, budget forecasts and management reporting
• Collaborate closely with Finance teams on cost allocation, financial planning and performance monitoring
• Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and Finance to ensure alignment on financial objectives and priorities
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within budgeting, reporting and governance processes

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Insurance or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business analysis, project management, transformation or change management
• Strong understanding of the Life Insurance sector, including products, regulations and market dynamics
• Experience supporting strategic planning, business transformation and roadmap execution
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial analysis and management reporting
• Proven ability to create impactful presentations and deliver effective executive-level storytelling
• Experience in process improvement and cross-functional project coordination
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multiple business functions
• Highly organized, autonomous and capable of challenging assumptions in a constructive manner
• Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear conclusions to management
• Fluency in French/Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?
 

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.
 

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Our client is a major real estate and infrastructure organization managing large-scale public-private partnership projects focused on the development, operation, and long-term maintenance of public facilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 25 building projects, coordinating maintenance activities and ensuring smooth collaboration between clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
• Act as the main point of contact for administrative, technical, contractual, insurance, and damage-related matters, while mediating conflicts and facilitating mutually acceptable solutions.
• Coordinate maintenance requests, technical inspections, change requests, and interventions through a dedicated helpdesk and ensure proper follow-up with the relevant parties.
• Monitor the technical condition, regulatory compliance, and overall performance of the buildings, including annual condition assessments based on NEN 2767 standards and follow-up of corrective actions.
• Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, meeting reports, and records in the document management system, while supporting stakeholders in improving the energy efficiency of the buildings.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Engineering, Facility Management, Real Estate, or equivalent professional experience, with 3-5 years of relevant experience in maintenance, technical consultancy, or real estate.
• Strong knowledge of building technical systems and maintenance requirements, ideally gained through experience with schools, offices, hospitals, or other large public/commercial buildings.
• Excellent communication, consultation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to mediate conflicts and build strong professional relationships.
• Proactive, customer-oriented, highly organized, and solution-driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as within multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good command of French and English, and proficient in MS Office and technical/construction documentation tools such as CAD and relevant maintenance or project-management applications.

Our client is an international engineering and project delivery organization managing complex EPC projects across industrial and infrastructure-related sectors.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities across Piping, Structures, Electrical, Instrumentation, HVAC/MEP, CAD, Construction, Procurement, suppliers, and offshore engineering teams.
• Develop and manage engineering schedules, deliverables, resources, engineering hours, budgets, and progress, using tools such as MS Project or equivalent.
• Lead technical coordination, interface management, design reviews, supplier technical discussions, and resolution of day-to-day engineering issues.
• Manage engineering risks, changes, technical clarifications, document control, and the complete deliverable cycle from IFR/IFD through IFC and as-built.
• Support constructibility, modularization, prefabrication, and site activities while ensuring the quality and integration of offshore engineering and CAD deliverables.

• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Project Engineering Manager, Senior Project Engineer, or Project Manager within EPC projects, with experience on at least two relevant EPC projects.
• Strong multidisciplinary engineering background, with solid knowledge of Piping & Structures as well as Electrical & Instrumentation; construction/site experience is an advantage.
• Ability to interpret complex engineering drawings, 3D models, CAD/BIM deliverables, specifications, datasheets, and calculation documentation.
• Experience with engineering planning and project tools such as MS Project, Primavera, Navisworks, or equivalent; knowledge of modularization and prefabrication is highly valued.
• Fluent English is mandatory; French is considered an advantage, with strong leadership, communication, organization, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

Our client is an innovative manufacturing company seeking an experienced engineering professional to strengthen its operations and accelerate continuous improvement projects.

Jobomschrijving

Are you commercially minded and do you enjoy working with customers? Are you looking for a job that is never the same and where you get opportunities to grow?

Then maybe you are our new CUSTOMER CARE REPRESENTATIVE!

For our client, the largest private rail freight operator in Europe, we are looking for a customer care representative to join the Freight Force.

As a customer care representative you will: Process owner for the booking & check-in process
  
• You accept bookings on customer request  
• You make bookings yourself of containers and wagons on trains and you send the booking instructions and agreements to Order Management  
• You inform and make the customer acquainted with the Customer Portal so that he is able to makes his own bookings. You assist the customer in every step of the booking process.  
• You manage changes of the original booking  
• You check if basic commercial data is known and is supported via the Customer Portal. If no, you inform and request assistance from Inside Sales to amend lacking commercial information  
• You rectify the missing and/or wrong contract number for import orders to ensure quick O2C  
• You make sure that all booking details are correct and that there are no anomalies that can slow down the order-to-cash process  
• You prepare template of the railway bill/consignment note.  
• You make the consignment note (as a paid service or if in high special need for assistance)
Commercial tasks
  
• You are able to maximize the fill rate of each train by finding the extra box/wagon and by consulting the customer on a professional and commercial way (based on parameters of Commercial Margin Management)  
• You manage the customer relation daily and (pro-) actively to create a lock-in opportunity and retain Customer satisfaction.  
• You build a customer relationship through high standard service delivery and execution.  
• You highten awareness and inform the client of successful products  
• You inform and share knowledge with other stake-holders within the company to inform and update on this new transport relation
Customer behavior
  
• You discuss and try to understand the booking behaviors and needs of the Customer via commercial discussions based on KPI’s (in relation to SLA)  
• You sharing info about the customer behavior with commercial stake-holders (commercial Margin Management/Key accountmanagers/Inside Sales/...)
Communication
  
• You are pro-actively by thinking with the customer, assessing and acting before possible incidents.  
• You assure the tracking & tracing (within office hours) via Customer Portal and other ways (digitalization is key and our future aim)  
• You receive and assist the Customer with his complaint within our organisation and stakeholders

Who are we looking for?

As a Customer Service Representative, you are primarily focused on customer service. You have a commercial mentality and are able to communicate with the customer in a professional way.
  
• You have a bachelor degree or equivalent through experience;  
• You have strong communication skills and are able to understand and translate the customers needs;  
• You speak English fluently. A good knowledge of French and Dutch is required. Knowledge of German or another language is a plus;  
• You have experience in managing an account and you are able to work on customer relations and loyalty;  
• You have knowledge of the various Microsoft Office programs and are quick to learn proprietary systems;  
• You are organized, detail-oriented and have the drive to work in a commercial and professional manner;  
• You have the necessary persuasiveness and commercial flair, are proactive and can work alone as well as in a team;  
• You are a multitasker and are someone who values efficiency;  
• You can cope with a changing environment.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.
